m: हैंसकायन mfn. (fr. हिंसक) g. पक्षादि.
हैङ्गुल mfn. (fr. हिङ्गुल) having the colour of vermilion, Naiṣ.
coming or derived from Hiṅgulā, VāmP.
हैदरशाह m. = حيدرشاۀ Cat.

s: hEhayaH

puM, (hayyA apatyam । “strIByo Qak .” 4 । 1 । 120 । iti Qak । pfzodarAditvAt sADuH । yadvA heSabdena nAmEkadezagrahaRena nAmagrahaRAt hezASabdena hezASabdaM kurvvan hayati gacCatIti hehayo'SvaH tasyAyaM “SivAdiByo'R .” 4 । 1 । 112 । ityaR । yadvA, he Bakta he Bakta iti vadan hayati gacCatIti hehayo vizRuH । tasyAyaM hEhayaH .) kArttavIryyaH । iti hemacandraH ॥ deSaviSezaH । yaTA, -- “paScime hEhayAstAdrimlecCavAsaSakAdayaH ॥” iti jyotistattve kUrmmacakram ॥
hEhayaH

puM, (hEhayAH taddeSavAsinaH tezAM rAjA aR .) kArttavIryyarAjaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (yaTA, raGO । 11 । 74 । “biBrato'stramacale'pyakuRWitaM dvO ripU mama matO samAgasO । DenuvatsaharaRAcca hEyayaH tvaYca kIrttimapaharttumudyataH ॥”)
v: hEhaya
pu॰ paScimasTe deSaviSeze vf॰ sa॰ kUrmaviBAga 2168 pf॰ dfSyam tezAM rAjA aR । 2 hEhayeSvare kArttavIryye hemaca॰ pfzA॰ hEheya tatrArTe Sabdara॰ ।
m: हैहय m. N. of a race (said to have been descendants of Yadu; they are described in the Purāṇas as separated into 5 divisions, viz. the Tālajaṅghas, Vīti-hotras, Āvantyas, Tuṇḍikeras, and Jātas; they are, said to have overrun parts of India along with the Śakas or Scythian tribes), MBh.; R.; Pur. &c.
a king of the Haihayas (esp. applied to Arjuna Kārtavīrya, who is said to have had a thousand arms; see कार्तवीर्य), ib.
N. of a son of Sahasrada, Hariv.
of a son of Śata-jit, Pur.
(?) of a medical author, Cat.
a: हैहय — m. pl. N. of a people and their country. --यः 1 N. of the great-grandson of Yadu. --2 N. of Arjuna Kārtavīrya (who had a thousand arms and was slain by Paraśurāma q. v.); धेनुवत्सहरणाच्च हैहयस्त्वं च कीर्तिमपहर्तुमुद्यतः R. 11. 74.

m: हैहयेन्द्र-काव्य n. N. of a poem.
हैहेय m. N. of Arjuna Kārtavīrya (cf. above), L.

v: hEmA(mI)

m: हैमा (आ), f. yellow jasmine, L.
हैमाङ्गिकी-गौराङ्ग-देव-स्तुति f. N. of wk.
हैमाचल m. = (or perhaps w.r. for) हिमाचल (q.v.), Subh.

हैमानेकार्थ N. of Hemacandra's lexicon.

strI, (hema tadvarRo'styasyAH iti aR । vA NIp .) pItayUTikA । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (yUTikASabde asyA vizayo jYAtavyaH ॥

Pandanus Odoratissimus, L.
हैमी-भूत mfn. become gold, turned into gold, Kum.

s: hEmaM

klI, (hime Bavam । aR .) prAtarhimodaBavajalam । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ himaBave, tri ॥ (yaTA, raGO । 16 । 7 । “labDAntarA sAvaraRe'pi gehe yogapraBAvo na ca lakzyate te । biBarzi cAkAramanirvftAnAM mfRAlinI hEmamivoparAgam ॥”) hemajAte ca tri ॥ ityamaraH । 2 । 8 । 32 ॥ (yaTA, raGO । 6 । 15 । “AkuYcitAgrANgulinA tato'nyaH kiYcit samAvarjjitanetraSoBaH । tiryyag visaMsapinaKapraBeRa pAdena hEmaM vilileKa pIWam ॥”)
hEmaH

puM, BUnimbaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ (hemno vikAraH । hema + aR .) hemno vikAraH । iti mugDaboDavyAkaraRam ॥ (SivaH । yaTA, mahABArate । 13 । 17 । 63 । “hEmo hemakaro yajYaH sarvvaDArI DarottamaH ॥” parvvataviSezaH । yaTA, mahABArate । 13 । 19 । 54 । “kElAsaM mandaraM hEmaM sarvvAnanucacAra ha । tAnatItya mahASElAn kErAtaM sTAnamuttamam ॥”)
v: hEma
tri॰ hime Bavam aR । 1 himajAtamAtre 2 prAtaHkAlInahimajAte jale na॰ rAjani॰ । 3 BUnimbe pu॰ rAjani॰ । hemno vikAraH aR wilopaH । 4 svarRavikAre 5 svarRamayapadArTe ca tri॰ ।
m: 1. हैम mfn. wintry, brumal, caused or produced by snow or ice, Ragh.
covered with s˚, MBh.
relating to or coming from the Himālaya (as pearls), MBh.; VarBṛS.
हैम m. N. of a mountain, MBh.
हैम n. hoar-frost, dew, W.
2. हैम mf(ई)n. (fr. 3. हेमन्, of which it is also the Vṛddhi form in comp.) golden, consisting or made of gold, Mn.; MBh. &c.
of a golden yellow colour, MW.
हैम m. N. of Śiva, MBh.
Gentiana Cherayta, L.
(scil. कोश) the lexicon of Hema-candra, Cat.
हैम , हैमन &c. See col. 1.
a: हैम — a. (मी f.) [हिम-हेमन्-अण्] 1 Cold, wintry, frigid. --2 Caused by frost; मृणालिनी हैममिवोपरागं R. 16. 7. --3 Golden, made of gold; पादेन हैमं विलिलेख पीठं R. 6. 15; Bk. 5. 89; Ku. 6. 6. --4 Of a golden yellow colour. --मा --मी Yellow jasmine. --मं Hoar-frost, dew. --मः An epithet of Śiva. --Comp. --मुद्रा, --मुद्रिका a golden coin.
हैमंतिक — a. [हेमंते काले भवः ठञ्] 1 Wintry, cold. --2 Growing in winter. --कं A kind of rice.

m: हैम—शैल m. N. of a mountain (v.l. हेम-श्˚), VP.
हैम—चन्द्रि m. patr. fr. हेमचन्द्र, R.
हैम—चर्चि m. (prob. w.r. for -वर्चि) a patr. Pravar.
हैम—चित्र-समुत्सेध mfn. enchased with golden pictures, MBh.
हैम—गिरिक m. pl. the inhabitants of Hema-giri, MārkP.
हैमहा ind. an exclamation, ŚrS.
हैम—कूट m. pl. the inhabitants of Hema-kūṭa, MārkP.
हैम—कोश m. Hema-candra's lexicon.

s: hEmalaH
puM, klI, (himala + aR .) hemanta ftuH । himalaSabdAt zRapratyayena nizpannaH । iti kAcit SabdaratnAvalI ॥ hEmana iti sADupAWaH ॥
v: hEmala

m: हैमल m. n. winter (prob. w.r. for हैमन), L.
हैम—मुद्रा or हैम—मुद्रिका, f. a g˚ coin, MW.

s: hEmanaM

klI, puM, (hemanta eva iti । “sarvvatrAR ca talopaSca .” 4 । 3 । 22 । iti svArTe aR talopaSca .) hemanta ftuH । yaTA । hemantahEmanAvastrI । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (hemna idamityaR । na wilopaH .) svarRajAte himajAte ca tri ॥ (hemantaBave ca tri । yaTA, kirAtArjjunIye । 17 । 12 । “umApatiM pARqusutapraRunnAH SiMlImuKAnavyaTayAmbaBUvuH । aByutTitasyAdripaternitambamarkasya pAdA iva hEmanasya ॥” ॥)
hEmanaH

puM, (hemanta eva aR । talopaSca .) mArgaSIrzamAsaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ (hemante jAtaH aR talopaSca .) himakAlodBavazazwikaDAnyam । asya guRAH । “hEmanAstu himA vfzyA maDurA badDavarccasaH .” iti rAjavallaBaH ॥
v: hEmana
pu॰ hemanta eva hemante Bavo vA aR talopaH । 1 hemante kAle Sabdara॰ । 2 tatra jAte tri॰ । heBna idamaR na wilopaH । svarRasambanDini tri॰ striyAM NIz ।
m: 1. हैमन mf(ई)n. relating or belonging or suitable to winter, winterly, wintry, cold, AV. &c. &c.
हैमन m. the month Mārgaśīrṣa (November-December), L.
a kind of rice which grows in winter (= षष्टिक), L.
हैमन m. n. winter, cold, L.
2. हैमन mfn. golden (v.l. हैमज), Bhpr.
a: हैमन — a. (नी f.) [हेमंत एव हेमंते भवो वा अण् तलोपः] 1 Wintry, cold; Śi. 6. 55, Ki. 17. 12. --2 Pertaining to winter, i. e. long (as nights); Śi. 6. 77. --3 Growing in or suitable for winter; हैमनैर्निवसनैः सुमध्यमाः R. 19. 41. --4 Golden, made of gold. --नः 1 The month Mārgaśīrsha. --2 The winter season (= हेमंत q. v.).

s: hEmantaM
klI, puM, (hemanta + “sanDivelAdyftunakzatreByo'R .” 4 । 3 । 16 । iti aR .) hemanta ftuH । hemantasambanDini, tri । iti hemantaSabdAt svArTe zRapratyayena nizpannam ॥
m: हैमन्त mf(ई)n. (fr., हेमन्त) wintry, relating or suitable to or growing in winter, VS.; Suśr. &c.

v: hEmantika

m: हैमन्तिक mfn. = prec. VS.; Br.; ŚrS.; Car.
= हेमतम् अधीते वेद वा, g. वसन्तादि.
हैम—प्राकृत-धुण्डिका f. N. of wk.
हैम—सौगन्धिक-वत् mfn. furnished with g˚ lotus-flowers (v.l. पद्म-स्˚), MBh.
हैम—वल्कल mfn. clothed in gold, MW.
हैमवत् m. N. of the 8th month (prob. w.r. for हिम-वत् or हैमवत), Sūryapr.

s: hEmavatI

strI, (himavato'patyaM strI । aR । NIp .) pAvvatI । (yaTA, devIBAgavate । 12 । 8 । 57 । “umABiDAnAM purato devIM hEmavatIM SivAm ॥”) harItakI । ityamaraH । 1 । 1 । 38 ; 2 । 4 । 59 ॥ svarRakzIrI । (asyAH paryyAyo yaTA, -- “kawuparRI hEmavatI hemakzIrI himAvatI । hemAhvA pItadugDA ca tanmalaYcokamucyate ॥” iti BAvaprakASasya pUrvvaKaRqe praTame BAge ॥) SvetavacA । iti medinI ॥ (asyAH paryyAyo yaTA, “zaqgranTyogrA vacA jYeyA SvetA hEmavatIti ca .” iti gAruqe 208 aDyAye ॥ himavataH praBavati prakASate praTamaM dfSyate iti । “praBavati .” 4 । 3 । 83 । ityaR .) gaNgA । iti DaraRiH ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 3 । 108 । 16 । “evamuktaH pratyuvAca rAjA hEmavatIM tadA । pitAmahA me varade ! kapilena mahAnadi ! anvezamARAsturagaM nItA vEvasvatakzayam ॥” himavati BavA iti । aR .) reRukA । kapiladrAkzA । atasI । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
m: हैमवती (अती), f. N. of various plants (Vacā with white flowers, Terminalia Chebula, Linum Usitatissimum &c.), Car.; Suśr.
a kind of drug or perfume (= रेणुका), L.
हैमवती patr. of Gaṅgā, MBh.; Bālar.
हैमवती N. of Pārvatī or Umā, JaimUp.
N. of the wife of Kauśika, MBh.
N. of the wife of Saṃhatāśva, Hariv.
a: हैमवती — 1 N. of Pārvatī. --2 Of the river Ganges. --3 A kind of myrobalan. --4 A kind of drug. --5 Common flax. --6 A tawny grape.

k.v: विभूतिर्भूतिरैश्वर्यमणिमादिकमष्टधा। अणिमा महिमा चैव गरिमा लघिमा तथा। प्राप्तिः प्राकाम्यमीशित्वं वशित्वं चाष्ट सिद्धयः। उमा कात्यायनी गौरी काली हैमवतीश्वरी॥
अभया त्वव्यथा पथ्या कायस्था पूतनामृता॥ हरीतकी हैमवती चेतकी श्रेयसी शिवा।
शुक्ला हैमवती वैद्यमातृसिंह्यौ तु वाशिका। वृषोऽटरूषः सिंहास्यो वासको वाजिदन्तकः॥
पटुपर्णी हैमवती स्वर्णक्षीरी हिमावती। हयपुच्छी तु काम्बोजी माषपर्णी महासहा॥

s: hEmavataM

hEmavataH
puM, vizaBedaH । iti hemacandraH ॥ (himAlayasambanDini, tajjAte ca tri ॥ deSaviSezaH । yaTA, mahABArate । 2 । 50 । 20 । “nizadAn pArasIkAMSca kfzRAn hEmavatAMstaTA ॥”)
v: hEmavata

na॰ himavato'dUraBavo deSaH tasyeda vA aR । 1 BAratavarzesya varzaBede trikA॰ । “etardDEmavataM varzaM BAratI yatra santatiH” vizRupu॰ । 2 himAlayasambanDini tri॰ 3 vizaBede pu॰ hemaca॰ । tasyApatyaM tatra Bavo vA aR । 5 pArvatyAM 6 harItakyAM amaraH strI NIp । 7 svarRakzIryyAM 8 SvetavacAyAYca strI medi॰ NIp 9 gaNgAyAM 10 reRukAyAM strI DaraRiH NIp ।
m: हैमवत mf(ई)n. (fr. हिम-वत्) belonging to or situated or growing on or bred in or coming or flowing from the Himālaya mountains, AV. &c. &c.
snowy, covered with snow, MW.
हैमवत m. a kind of vegetable poison, L.
a kind of demon, MānGṛ.
pl. the inhabitants of the Himālaya mountains, MBh.; Hariv.
N. of a school, Buddh.
हैमवत n. a pearl, L.
N. of a Varṣa, MBh.; Śatr.
a: हैमवत — a. (ती f.) [हिमवतो अदूरभवो देशः तस्येदं वा अण्] 1 Snowy. --2 Flowing from the snowy, i. e. Himālaya, mountain; R. 16. 44. --3 Bred in, belonging to, or situated on, the Himālaya mountain; Ku. 3. 23, 2. 67. --तः A kind of poison. --तं Bhāratavarṣa or India.

s: hEmavatavarzaM
klI, BAratavarzam । yaTA, -- “etadDEmavataM varzaM BAratI yatra santatiH । hemakUwaM paraM yatra namnA kiMpuruzottamaH ॥” iti vArAhe rudragItA ॥

m: हैमवतिक m. pl. the inhabitants of the Himālaya mountains, MBh.
हैम—विभ्रम-सूत्र n. = हेम-व्˚, Cat.
हैमिनी f. N. of a woman, MārkP.
हैडिम्ब mfn. relating to or treating of Hiḍimba, MBh.
= next, ib.
हैडिम्बि m. ‘son of Hiḍimbā’, metron. of Ghaṭotkaca, MBh.
हैरण्वती f. (cf. हिरण्वती) N. of a river, MBh.
हैरण्य mf(आ)n. (fr. हिरण्य, of which it is also the Vṛddhi form in comp.) golden, consisting or made of gold, AV.; R.
bearing gold (said of a river), MBh.
offering gold (said of hands or arms), ib.
हैरण्य—बाहेय m. patr. fr. हिरण्य-बाहु, Pat.
हैरण्य—गर्भ mfn. relating or belonging to Hiraṇya-garbha, Śaṃk.
हैरण्य—गर्भ m. patr. of Manu (son of Brahmā), Mn. iii, 194
of Vasiṣṭha, MBh.
a worshipper of Hiraṇya-garbha, Cat.
हैरण्यक m. a goldsmith, VarBṛS.
an overseer of gold, guardian of golden treasure, L.
हैरण्यक n. N. of a Varṣa, MBh.
हैरण्य—नाभ m. patr. fr. हिरण्य-न्˚, ŚBr.
हैरण्य—स्तूप mf(ई)n. written or composed by Hiraṇyastūpa (also ˚पीय), Nir.; ŚāṅkhGṛ.
हैरण्य—स्तूप m. patr. of Arcat (author of RV. x, 149), Anukr.
हैरण्य—वासस् mfn. (fr. हिरण्यव्˚) clothed with golden feathers (as an arrow), MBh.
हैरण्यिक mf(आ or ई)n. (fr. हिरण्य) g. काश्यादि
हैरण्यिक m. a goldsmith, Divyāv.
हैरम्ब mfn. relating to or connected with Gaṇeśa, Cat.
हैरम्ब m. pl. N. of a sect, W.
हैरम्ब , हैरिक. See above, col. 2.

हैतनामन m. id., MaitrS.

s: hEtukaH

puM, (hetunA caratIti । hetu + Wak । sadyuktivyavaMhArI । yaTA, manuH । “trEvidyo hEtukastarkI nirukto DarmmapAWakaH । trayaScASramiRaH pUrvve parizat syAddaSAvarA ॥” trEvidyaH trivedapAragaH । hEtukaH sadyuktivyavahArI । iti vyavahAratattvam ॥ hetudvArA satkarmmasu sandehakarttA । yaTA, -- “pAzaRqino vikarmmasTAn vEqAlavratikAn SaWAn । hEtukAn vakavfttIMSca vANmAtreRApi nArccayet ॥” iti vizRupurARe । 3 । 18 । 99 ॥ pAzaRqAdInAM lakzaRam “BrazwaH svaDarmmAt pAzaRqo vikarmmasTo nizidDakft । yasya DarmmaDvajo nityaM suraDvaja ivocCritaH । pracCannAni ca pApAni vEqAlaM nAma tadvratam ॥” tadvAn vEqAlavratikaH । “priyaM vakti puro'nyatra vipriyaM kurute BfSam । vyaktAparADacezwaSca SaWo'yaM kaTito buDEH ॥ sandehakft hetuBiryaH satkarmmasu sa hEtukaH । arvvAgdfzwirnEkftikaH svArTasADanatatparaH । SaWo miTyAvinItaSca vakavfttirudAhftaH ॥” iti tawwIkA ॥ (PalABisanDAnayukte, tri ॥)
v: hEtuka
tri॰ hetO prasftaH WaR । hetuvAdarate sayuktikavAkyavAdini “trEvidyo hEtukastarkI nErukto DarmapAWakaH” parzallakzaRe manuH ।
m: हैतुक mf(ई)n. having a cause or reason, founded on some motive (in अ-ह्˚), Bhag.; BhP.
(ifc.) caused by, dependent on MBh.; BhP.
हैतुक m. a reasoner, rationalist, sceptic, heretic (f(ई). ), Mn.; Yājñ.; MBh. &c.
हैतुक m. a follower of the Mīmāṃsā doctrines, W.
हैतुक , ˚क्य. See p. 1304, col. 1.
a: हैतुक — a. (की f.) [हेतौ प्रसृतः ठण्] 1 Causal, causative. --2 Argumentative, rationalistic. --कः 1 A logical reasoner, an arguer. --2 A follower of the Mīmāṃsā doctrines. --3 A rationalist, sceptic. --4 A heretic.

m: हैतुक्य n. causality, causativeness (अ-हैतुक्य n. ‘absence of interested motives’), MW.
हैवम् ind. = Pāli hevam, Divyāv.
हैयंगवीन n. clarified butter prepared from yesterday's milking, fresh butter, Hariv.; Ragh.; Bhaṭṭ.
a: हैयंगवीनं — [ह्योगोदोहात् भवं ह्यस् गो ख नि˚] 1 Clarified butter prepared from the preceding day's milk, fresh ghee; हैयंगवीनमादाय घोषवृद्धानुपस्थितान् R. 1. 45; Bk. 5. 12. --2 Butter prepared a day before it is used, fresh butter.

m: हैयंगव n. (fr. ह्यस् + गो) = next, BhP.

s: hEyaNgavInaM

klI, (hyo godohasya vikAraH iti । “hEyaNgavInaM saMjYAyAm .” 5 । 2 । 23 । iti KaY hiyaNgvAdeSaSca .) sadyogodohodBavaM Gftam । ityamaraH । 2 । 9 । 52 ॥ navanItam । iti ratnamAlA rAjanirGaRwaSca ॥ (yaTA, harivaMSe । BavizyaparvvaRi । 58 । 10 । “hEyaNgavInaM kzIrARi daDi vA kimajIjanan । goDanaM sarvvamevedaM nIrogaM pratipadyate ॥”) tatparyyAyaH । sarajam 2 manTajam 3 kala mvuwam 4 । iti hArAvalI ॥
v: hEyaNgavIna
na॰ hyogodohAd Bayam hyas + go + Ka ni॰ । 1 navanIte ratnamA॰ । pUrvadinadugDodBave 2 Gfte ca amaraH ।

k.v: घृतमाज्यं हविः सर्पिर्नवनीतं नवोद्घृतम्. तत्तु हैयङ्गवीनं यद्ध्योगोदोहोद्भवं घृतम्.।
